{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Sutemribor Brass Solid Round Rod Lathe Bar Stock, 3/8 Inch in Diameter 14 Inches in Length (2 PCS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My projects involve electronics and practical hardware, but I have no current need for lathe stock.
ItemID: 2; Title: Multifunction Meter DIY kit, kuman Mega 328 Graphic transistor Tester, NPN PNP Diodes Triode Capacitor ESR SCR MOSFET Resistor Inductance LCD Display Checker with case and screwdriver K77; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to identify and check components for my breadboard and PCB projects.
ItemID: 3; Title: 150 Pcs 15 Value 100 ohm- 2M ohm Trimpot Variable Resistor 6mm Potentiometer Assortment Kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Adjustable resistors fit my circuit-building interests, and I would choose this assortment for tuning prototypes.
ItemID: 4; Title: Degraw 5kg Load Cell and HX711 Combo Pack Kit - Load Cell Amplifier ADC Weight Sensor for Arduino Scale - Everything Needed for Accurate Force Measurement; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits Arduino experimentation, but I do not currently have a weighing or force-measurement project.
ItemID: 5; Title: DC Power Supply Adjustable (30V 10A), Eventek Variable Switching Regulated Digital Power Supply with Alligator Leads US Power Cord (30V 10A); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose one adjustable supply to power and test circuits alongside my breadboards and relay modules.
ItemID: 6; Title: RSC Mighty Mag Magnetic Base, Made in USA Caliper and Indicator Accessory; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no clear use for a machining measurement accessory in my current electronics projects.
ItemID: 7; Title: KeeYees 3pcs BME280 Digital 5V Temperature Humidity Sensor Atmospheric Barometric Pressure Board IIC I2C Breakout for Arduino; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for an Arduino environmental-monitoring project, extending my interest in temperature measurement.
ItemID: 8; Title: 30V/ 10A DC Power Supply, Dr.meter Variable 4-Digits LED Display Power Supply, Multifuncitonal and Switching DC Regulated Power Supply with USB Interface, Alligator Leads US Power Cord for Laboratory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A bench supply suits my projects, but I would only choose one this time and have already selected another.
ItemID: 9; Title: DC Power Supply Variable 30V 10A, 4-Digital LED Display, Precision Adjustable Switching Regulated Multifunctional Power Supply Digital with USB Interface, Disply with Output Power Lab Grade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It meets the same circuit-testing need as the supply I selected, so I would skip a duplicate purchase.
ItemID: 10; Title: Glarks 5Pcs Stainless Steel Screw Thread Pitch Cutting Gauge Tool Set, 51Pcs America SAE Type + 52Pcs Metric & America SAE Type & British Whitworth + 3Pcs Center Gage, Packed in Plastic Box; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My caster purchase suggests occasional hardware work, but I have no current need to measure thread pitches."}
